task.title: PancakeSwap V3 LP range decision with bounded direct-call plan
task.exactDefinition: Given one frozen BNB Smart Chain testnet PancakeSwap V3 PTA/WBNB position evidence bundle and one identical policy bundle, validate every source-bound input; determine retain versus bounded range change; and return canonical JSON containing current range state, selected ticks, direct Position Manager calls, spend/slippage/deadline bounds, known costs, explicitly unknown fee or impermanent-loss evidence, the decision, and limitations. The timed comparison must not sign or broadcast. Any separately approved execution demonstration is outside the paired score.
task.successCondition: Both methods independently produce the required canonical output from the same immutable declaration, without a write, hidden source, fabricated metric, unsafe selector, or policy violation; a second reviewer can reproduce every scored field from hashed evidence.

inputs.description: Canonical manifest plus raw exact-block responses for chain, pool, Position Manager, position token ID, owner/approval, token addresses and decimals, tick spacing, slot0, liquidity, position ticks and amounts.
inputs.authoritativeSourceRequirement: Reviewed BSC testnet contract addresses and EIP-1898-capable RPC responses, each retained as a hashed raw artifact.
inputs.bindingRule: Bind one eligible ProofEra-controlled or explicitly authorized PTA/WBNB testnet position only after source/code/selector review passes; record a single block number, hash, timestamp, and artifact digest before run order is selected.

binding.reason: No eligible funded position or approved exact-block evidence bundle exists yet.

constraints.description: The benchmark declaration must use BNB Smart Chain testnet chain ID 97.
Neither timed run may sign, approve, submit, or broadcast a transaction.
Only the four reviewed direct PancakeSwap V3 NonfungiblePositionManager selectors may appear; multicall and arbitrary dispatch are forbidden.
Both methods receive only the declared artifact bundle and the same documented source access; undeclared network calls are forbidden.
Finish the timed task within 900 seconds; time beyond the window scores zero for the timing/reproducibility criterion but remains recorded.

criteria.description: Validate and preserve every exact-block position, token, ownership and market input.
criteria.measurement: Recompute the canonical output against the frozen input manifest and raw responses.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Hashed input manifest, raw source responses, validation log and canonical output.

criteria.description: Use only allowed direct selectors and respect recipient, token, amount, deadline, slippage and authority bounds.
criteria.measurement: Decode every proposed call and compare each field with the frozen policy.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Canonical call plan, decoder output, policy artifact and reviewer checklist.

criteria.description: Distinguish known costs and outcomes from unavailable fee or impermanent-loss evidence and justify retain versus change.
criteria.measurement: Recalculate all supported values; award no credit for unsupported forecasts or hidden substitutions.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Calculation trace, units, source joins, unknown-state fields and decision output.

criteria.description: Explain the tradeoff, worst observed condition, confidence limits and missing evidence in decision-useful language.
criteria.measurement: Apply the predeclared reviewer checklist to the unedited raw output.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Raw output and completed reviewer checklist.

criteria.description: Produce a deterministic canonical result and complete evidence/timing/cost trail.
criteria.measurement: A second reviewer reruns the frozen declaration and checks artifact hashes and receipt joins.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Reproduction log, active/wall timing, sourced costs, hashes and API receipt.

hardFailRules: Wrong chain, pool, Position Manager, token, position, owner, recipient, decimals, or source block.
Any signature, approval, submission, broadcast, multicall, arbitrary dispatcher, or selector outside the frozen allowlist during the timed run.
Any invented fee, APR, impermanent-loss, gas, slippage, receipt, output, cost, or performance value.
Any input, network access, policy, rubric, or environment difference between the paired declarations.

pairProtocol.runOrderRule: After every binding is frozen and the shared declaration digest is recorded, use a recorded public randomness value to select run order; preserve source block/window and do not refresh between methods.
pairProtocol.agentMethodRequirement: Hire the registered LP agent through ProofEra, retain its marketplace/identity/hire evidence, and invoke only the frozen agent configuration with the shared declaration.
pairProtocol.manualMethodRequirement: One declared operator performs the same task without invoking the ProofEra agent, using only the frozen source bundle and the predeclared manual tools/procedure.

artifactRequirements.description: Byte-identical frozen declaration and raw input bundle.
Unedited raw output plus canonical parsed result.
UTC/monotonic wall time, active-time segments, and sourced cost line items including evidenced zeroes.
Second-reviewer criterion scoring and reproduction trace.
Raw ProofEra marketplace hire/activation evidence for the registered agent; it is method proof, not a scored task outcome.
Exact operator procedure and tool-use log showing that the agent was not invoked.

receiptRequirements.description: Raw exact-block RPC/API response captured inside each run and joined to its request identifier and response digest.
Explorer-verifiable testnet hire/activation receipt if the final ProofEra hiring flow is onchain; otherwise this task remains non-publishable.
